1.  The instant petition has as been filed by the petitioner for directions to the respondents respondent No.1 to 3 to file the status report in the FIR No.269 dated 14.11.2024 under Sections 420, 406 and 34 of Indian Penal Code, Police Station Rama Mandi, Jalandhar.
2.

The learned counsel sel representing the petitioner submits that the petitioner has filed the representation (Annexure P-4) before the Director General of Police, Punjab, Chandigarh,
respondents No.2 and 3..
The learned counsel prays for directions to the respondent No. No.2 to decide the abovementioned representation representation within a stipulated time.
3. Notice of motion to the respondents No.1 to 3 only only.

sentences.text:
Keeping in view the aforesaid facts, the present petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to the respondent No.2 to decide the representation of the petitioner (Annexure P P-4)
4) by passing a speaking order within a period of 15 days from the date of receipt of copy of ins instant tant order.
It is however clarified that no finding is being returned, by this Court, with regard to merits of the contents of representation.
The respondent No.2 shall be at liberty to make an independent assessment with regard to contents of representation of the petitioner and make an independent decision at his own representation level.
